findings.location: Paragraph 2, sentence 3 of the B-page summary: “the three limit theorems.”
findings.evidence: The assigned example declares the two model/scaling definitions and the two-velocity heat-limit theorem as dependencies. The mean-field prerequisite page describes mean-field limit results, but neither the example nor the B-page summary identifies an exact hard-sphere Boltzmann–Grad theorem and its hypotheses. The collision-transport prerequisite page says it asserts no hard-sphere Boltzmann–Grad derivation or general hydrodynamic limit, and the assigned scaling definition disclaims convergence to Boltzmann. If this phrase refers to external results, name them and their conditions; otherwise revise it to describe the three prescriptions.
